description: This file defines and implements the MCPManager type, which manages MCP server lifecycle including addition, removal, starting, stopping, status reporting, capability discovery, and skill generation within a software project. It interacts with configuration files, external protocols, and YAML for managing MCP servers.

classes.name: MCPManager
classes.description: Manages MCP server lifecycle, capabilities discovery, and skill generation within a workspace.

classes.name: MCPServerInfo
classes.description: Struct containing status and metadata info about an MCP server.

classes.name: MCPProcess
classes.description: Represents an MCP server process instance.

classes.name: MCPManifest
classes.description: Contains details about tools and resources discovered from an MCP server.

classes.name: MCPServerConfig
classes.description: Configuration parameters for an MCP server.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Serializes and saves MCP server configuration to disk.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads MCP server configuration from disk.

methods.name: getServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves status and metadata about a specific MCP server.

methods.name: updateAgentFieldYAML
methods.description: Updates the agentfield.yaml file with MCP server configuration.

methods.name: removeMCPFromAgentFieldYAML
methods.description: Removes an MCP server's configuration from agentfield.yaml.

methods.name: loadMCPConfigsFromYAML
methods.description: Parses MCP configurations from agentfield.yaml (reserved for future use).

methods.name: DiscoverCapabilities
methods.description: Discovers tools and resources capabilities of an MCP server, either via URL or local process.

methods.name: discoverFromURL
methods.description: Discovers capabilities from a remote MCP server URL.

methods.name: discoverFromLocalProcess
methods.description: Discovers capabilities from a local MCP server process.

methods.name: connectAndDiscover
methods.description: Establishes connection to MCP server endpoint for capability discovery (reserved for future use).

methods.name: parseCapabilityResponse
methods.description: Parses a raw response from MCP capabilities discovery.

methods.name: cacheCapabilities
methods.description: Caches the discovered capabilities to disk.

methods.name: GenerateSkills
methods.description: Generates Python skills for an MCP server based on discovered capabilities.
